Theme: lost polar military expeditions, weathered white-grey heavy uniforms and fur, frost-encrusted iron, glacier-blue relics, snow and ice on bases, wolf and ancient ice runes, diesel machinery, grounded gritty cold atmosphere. Era: 1930s/1940s industrial warfare, occult diesel engines; NO futuristic lasers.
COMPOSITION: landscape 1536x1024, strict THREE COLUMNS by TWO ROWS, six equally sized cells. One COMPLETE figurine centered inside each cell, with generous empty transparent margins on all sides, never touching or crossing a cell border. Common 3/4 isometric camera, high detailed realistic hand-painted game miniature rendering. Every figurine has its own matching dark round/oval scenic stone base. Ground shadows only on base; aircraft on slender transparent stand above their base. Full weapons and flags entirely within each cell. No labels, no letters, no watermark, no frame. TRUE RGBA TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND outside the six silhouettes and their bases. No studio backdrop, no haze, no checkerboard, no gradients.
EXACT ordered contents, read left-to-right top row then bottom row:
1. Fantassin du pergélisol: standing industrial era rifle infantry in field uniform holding a bolt-action rifle.
2. Mitrailleur du bunker gelé: heavy infantry operating a portable belt-fed machine gun on a bipod, ammo belts.
3. Briseur de glaciers: infantry soldier holding a bulky early shoulder-fired anti-tank rocket launcher.
4. Moto chenillée: military half-track snow motorcycle with rider and mounted machine gun.
5. Side-car du blizzard: military motorcycle with armored sidecar carrying a mounted machine gun and gunner.
6. Dragon des neiges: industrial era cavalry dragoon in uniform riding an armored large shaggy wolf and holding a carbine.
All six are different designs; consistent scale and style. Dark grounded military fantasy compatible with medieval occult WWII game. Keep minute detail readable as a 150px icon.
